questions.question_text: When was the Punjab Transparency & Right to Information Act passed?
questions.explanation: The Punjab Transparency & Right to Information Act was passed in 2013 to provide procedures for citizens to access public information.

questions.question_text: Which institution regulates the recruitment policy in the province of Punjab?
questions.explanation: S&GAD is the department that manages the civil services and guidelines for recruitment across the Punjab government.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Governor-General of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Muhammad Ali Jinnah served as the first Governor-General of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: In which year was the Objective Resolution passed?
questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was passed by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.

questions.question_text: Who is known as the poet of the East?
questions.explanation: Allama Iqbal is celebrated as the national poet of Pakistan and the poet of the East.

questions.question_text: Which is the national language of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Urdu is the official national language of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Which mountain range is located in the north of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Pakistan is home to the Karakoram, Himalayas, and Hindukush mountain ranges.

questions.question_text: What is the total area of Pakistan in square kilometers?
questions.explanation: The approximate total land area of Pakistan is 796,095 square kilometers.

questions.question_text: When did Pakistan win the Cricket World Cup?
questions.explanation: Pakistan won its first and only ICC Cricket World Cup title in 1992 under Imran Khan's captaincy.

questions.question_text: Which province of Pakistan has the largest population?
questions.explanation: Punjab is the most populous province of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Prime Minister of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Liaquat Ali Khan was the inaugural Prime Minister of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Which city is known as the 'City of Lights'?
questions.explanation: Karachi is famously known as the City of Lights.
